Ben (Support): Escalating to CS — BrightLane trial blocked on SSO provisioning. Ticket #12345 shows repeated 403s on /v1/provision. Mid-trial, renewal ~28 days. Need priority.
Aisha (CS): On it. Quick q: customer tier and any committed ARR?
Ben (Support): Starter trial, no ARR yet. Usage spiked after a big ingest test, probably hit quota. Error excerpt: {"error":"quota_exceeded", "code":403}. Logs linked in ticket.
Carlos (SE): Seen this before — bursty embed jobs + key rotation can break SSO provisioning. Recs: instant 48h quota bump, enable smaller batch fallback, collect full request logs.
Aisha (CS): Comms plan proposal: 1) Immediate outreach acknowledging impact, 2) Offer 48h quota bump & temporary workaround, 3) 30m zoom with SE + eng to triage, 4) Capture onboarding doc feedback. Owner: Jordan to lead outreach.
Jordan (CS Manager): I9ll own outreach. @Vivian (AE) please add account/rev context for the convo. Jordan: will draft email and timeline.
Vivian (AE): Include renewal-sensitive line: 28We9re prioritizing your pilot completion and will provide a clear remediation timeline.2 Keep tone proactive.
Ben (Support): Ticket update: "Escalated to CS. Temporary quota bump +1000 units applied for 48h. POC: Jordan." Customer curl they sent: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -d '{"tenant":"brightlane"}'`
Aisha (CS): Draft email will be posted in 10m. Subject: "Redwood — immediate SSO support & trial access update".
Jordan (CS Manager): Call scheduled: 2024-03-05 16:00 PST (30m). Invites: BrightLane, SE, Ben. Action items: (A) Jordan: send email + outreach, (B) Carlos/SE: confirm quota bump and triage logs, (C) Maya/Docs: add SSO runbook bullet, (D) CS: log renewal risk in CRM.
Maya (Docs): Will prioritize SSO runbook patch and onboarding bullets by EOB tomorrow.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: After call we9ll create a short playbook entry so this doesn't recur. I9ll also set a 48h follow-up and retention flag in CRM 1 (proactive enablement).
Ben (Support): Note in ticket: "Customer unblocked? pending call. If still blocked after quota bump, escalate to eng oncall."
Jordan (CS Manager): I9ll post the customer-facing email here for review. Expect a 48h postmortem with root cause and remediation steps.

-- End thread --
